name: blue-ridge-deal-finder-site
_gate_note: The gates are chained EXPLICITLY inside `build`, not expressed as prebuild/
postbuild lifecycle scripts. That is deliberate and load-bearing:
`.npmrc` sets ignore-scripts=true (mirroring the repo root, RT-11), and that
flag suppresses pre/post lifecycle scripts for `npm run` as well as for
install. Written the idiomatic way, verify-data / verify-noindex /
verify-no-pii were all defined, all correct, and INVOKED BY NOTHING — the
build printed a clean green with zero gates having executed. Measured here
on 2026-08-19, not theorised. If you refactor these back into prebuild/
postbuild, re-measure that they actually run before believing them.

scripts.build: node scripts/verify-data.mjs && astro build && node scripts/verify-noindex.mjs && node scripts/verify-no-pii.mjs
